artworks.title: Grotteschi
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Alice Steiner in memory of John H. Steiner
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two vertical ornamental designs featuring intricate scrollwork and motifs. The drawing features two ornate vertical patterns side by side, each composed of flowing, interconnected scrollwork and decorative elements. The design on the left includes elaborate curves and interlocking shapes. The section on the right showcases a similar intricate design, with elements that appear to depict fanciful scrolls, floral motifs, and possibly animal figures. The detailed nature of the designs suggests a sort of architectural or decorative pattern.

artworks.title: Avarice
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with gold
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: Drawn with pen and brown ink on pale brown paper, a man and woman are surrounded by three skeletons in this vertical composition. The woman sits facing and looking out at us on the right half of the drawing. She sits next to a cloth-covered table, which spans the left half of the composition. The woman rests one elbow on the table in her head in that hand and holds a sack down between her knees with the other. She wears long, voluminous robes over a low-cut bodice. Vessels, jewels, a chest, and other sacks line the floor around her bare feet. A balding, bearded man sits on the far side of the table from her. He is along the left edge of the drawing and faces our right in profile. He writes with a quill on an angled writing desk with an ink well closer to us and an ornate jar on the far side. The leftmost of the three skeletons behind them has a goatee and faces our right in profile, both hands raised. The middle skeleton, between the man and woman, has curly hair and holds a tablet with both bony hands. The third skeleton, to the right, has bat-like wings and holds a sack up in one hand and lifts the other hand high. That raised hand nearly brushes a flying creature with a torso like a plucked turkey, frog legs, a lizard-like, gaping mouth, and three-lobed dragonfly wings. The scene takes place under a deep arch. Through the opening to the right, a person wearing armor raises a sword over another person who crouches and holds up one hand in protection. Touches of gold create delicate highlights on the skeleton’s bones, the people’s features and bodies, and the luxurious objects spread across the picture. The drawing is signed with a monogram with the letters “ILHR” and the date 1590 in the lower left corner. The bag the woman holds is inscribed “cehim” and another at her feet is inscribed “ongavi.”

artworks.title: Venus at the Forge of Vulcan
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and touches of white gouache
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene. The composition is crafted with ink and wash, showcasing cherubic figures and mythical beings. At the center, a pair of figures are entwined in an embrace, surrounded by swirling clouds and atmospheric whirls. Surrounding cherubic figures float amidst the clouds, engaging in playful antics and gestures. The use of soft, monochromatic tones imbues the image with a sense of antiquity and romance.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Woman
artworks.artist: Gilles Demarteau, the Elder after Jean-Baptiste Le Prince
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in red and black
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a person's head and upper body. The person is depicted in a slightly turned position, gazing upwards to the right of the viewer. Their facial features include a soft, rounded face with a serene expression. The hair is long, flowing, and adorned with delicate flowers, giving it a wreath-like appearance. The hair falls in curls and braids down the shoulders. The person appears to be wearing a draped garment, which is visible over one shoulder. There are no noticeable pieces of jewelry or objects being held. The background consists of textured, cross-hatched lines, creating depth and shadow, within a bordered frame that surrounds the drawing.

artworks.title: Eros and Psyche
artworks.artist: Jean-Claude-Richard, Abbé de Saint-Non after François Boucher
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of cherubic figures in a celestial scene. The artwork depicts several cherub-like figures situated among clouds. The main focus is on a central figure with wings, who appears to be playfully interacting with other cherubs around it. The figures are dynamically posed, adding a sense of movement to the composition. The use of monochrome shading with varying degrees of sepia tones creates a sense of depth and volume. The scene is enclosed within an oval frame.

artworks.title: On the Sands
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with pen and black ink over graphite

artworks.title: Danger
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite
artworks.description: This painting shows two women walking towards the left on a gray-brown shore, dressed in white blouses and blue skirts, one wearing red stockings. They both have pale skin, and their faces are turned away from us. Their skirts are blowing in the wind, and strands of dark hair have come out of their low buns. The sea behind them is turbulent with crashing white and blue waves, under a dark gray overcast sky. The shore is dotted with small areas of green, white, and rusty red. The scene is painted in soft and fluid strokes.

artworks.title: Mending the Nets
artworks.medium: transparent and opqaue watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: Two pale-skinned young women sit side-by-side on a bench so both face our right in profile as one knits and one mends a fishing net in this vertical watercolor. Both have pale skin with flushed cheeks and long blond hair. They wear long skirts, clog-like shoes, and the bodices have elbow-length sleeves. The woman closer to us has her hair pulled back under a band so wavy tendrils fall around her shoulders. She holds knitting needles and her work in one hand and pulls a thread of robin’s egg-blue yarn up with the other. The ball of yarn sits on the cobblestoned ground, and she lifts the string with her elbow raised so her hand is by her face. She looks down at the yarn. Her shirt is muted yellow over a red cloth across her chest. Her lap is covered by a tawny-brown cloth over her celestial-blue skirt, and her ankles are crossed.  The farther woman’s hair is up, and she wears marine blue with brick-red stockings. She leans forward with a tool in her right hand, that elbow tucked back by her side. With her other hand, she holds the end of a fishing net that hangs on a wall opposite the women. An oval basket also hangs on the wall, which edges into the scene along the right edge of the paper. The cobblestones fade out rapidly beyond the sage-green bench, and the background is cream-white. The artist signed and dated the lower left corner, “Winslow Homer 1882.”

artworks.title: View of Santiago de Cuba
artworks.medium: watercolor and pen and black ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: This painting shows a landscape with a village seen from above. The view includes red rooftops and a white church with dome-shaped structures. In the background, there are distant mountains in shades of purple, blue, and red. There are dark green trees on the left, in front of what looks like a pale body of water. Closest to us is a strip of green that suggests a hilltop. The sky above is cloudy, with shades of gray and cream. The brushstrokes in the painting are thick and fluid.

artworks.title: Palm Trees, Red
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper

artworks.title: Standing Nude
artworks.medium: black chalk with gouache on brown paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 64.5 x 34.2 cm (25 3/8 x 13 7/16 in.)
support: 66.3 x 35.5 cm (26 1/8 x 14 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a standing person. The person's right hand is on their hip and the left arm is by their side. The person's facial features include slightly parted lips, a nose, and eyes. The hair is shoulder-length and curly. The person is naked. The drawing emphasizes the lines and shadows of the body. The background is plain paper.

artworks.title: Piazza San Marco
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite with scratching on wove paper

artworks.title: Mountain Landscape with a Hollow
artworks.medium: brush drawing in brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a mountain landscape seen from a slightly elevated point. The horizon line is high, with mountain peaks dominating the background. The painting features detailed brushstrokes depicting the terrain and vegetation. The scene is in a monochromatic sepia tone, giving it a warm and vintage aesthetic. In the foreground, there are dense shrubs and bushes, leading to fields and wooded areas toward the foothills. The sky above has soft clouds blending into the landscape.

artworks.title: An Elderly Woman in a Striped Shawl
artworks.medium: pastel and watercolor on two joined sheets of blue paper, mounted on white paper and on original strainer
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly woman in a shoulder-length portrait. She is positioned facing the viewer with a subtle tilt of her head to the right. Her facial features include aged, wrinkled skin with a fair complexion, deeply set eyes, and defined cheekbones. Her hair is mostly covered by a cloth, but it appears greyish in color, peeking out slightly from under a plaid headscarf that is draped over her head and shoulders. The scarf is primarily tan with blue and grey stripes. Her clothing is partially visible, revealing a textured garment with a fur-like appearance. She wears a pearl earring in her left ear. The background is a simple, muted green tone.

artworks.title: A Lake in the Tyrol (Un lac du Tyrol)
artworks.medium: etching in red-brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene with a large tree dominating the left side, a figure in a boat on the right, a calm body of water, and a distant landform on the horizon. The artwork features expressive brushstrokes, a mono-tonal sepia color palette, and a dynamic play of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Studies of Legs and Drapery [recto]
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with white
artworks.description: This is a drawing of draped fabric and limbs. It features textured fabric and the anatomical elements of legs and arms, depicted with lines and tonal shades. The focus is on the dynamic flow and folds of the clothing, rendered in a reddish-orange hue to accentuate volume and movement. The lower limbs and feet are visible, drawn with anatomical accuracy showcasing muscular structure and foot positioning. The drawing suggests movement based on the placement and orientation of the fabric and limbs.

artworks.title: Studies of Hands and Bending Figures [verso]
artworks.medium: red chalk heightened with white
artworks.description: The image comprises multiple studies focusing on figures, with segments highlighting parts such as torsos, limbs, and pieces of clothing. One figure is seated, facing diagonally with hands held up in front, palms open. The facial features are simplified, with defined lines marking the hair. The figure is draped in flowing garments, indicated by sweeping lines and folds. Around the figures are studies of hands and cloth as individual elements. The drawing is on a light-toned background, creating a contrast with the reddish color and white highlights used for dimension and detail.

artworks.title: Saints Peter and John Healing the Lame Man at the Golden Gate
artworks.medium: etching
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered around columns. The figures are engaged in an action or conversation. The composition is balanced between the columns. The use of hatching and line work suggests depth and contrast. The columns provide a structural element that divides the piece into sections. Each figure is clad in flowing garments. The interactions and gestures imply a narrative moment captured within this architectural setting.

artworks.title: Urania
artworks.medium: gray and brown chalk with pen and brown ink (the head, the undergarment, and the right hand are traced with pen and black ink)
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated in a turned position, with an updo and a headscarf. She wears a robe and drop earrings, with her hands resting in her lap. In the background, there are swirling patterns.

artworks.title: The Revenge of the Sorcerer Virgil
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure holding a staff. The scene is detailed, with the figure sitting on a structure. Another figure in the foreground is holding a cylindrical object. The background is filled with various elements and figures, adding depth to the image. The figures are depicted with fine lines and hatching for texture and shadows.

artworks.title: Trees Reflected in a Brook
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 21.7 x 24.7 cm (8 9/16 x 9 3/4 in.)
overall (mount): 31.3 x 34.6 cm (12 5/16 x 13 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene viewed from the water's edge, showing a horizon of trees with branches leaning into the water. A figure is near the water, reaching into it. The artwork is in brown ink on cream paper, with detailed brushstrokes conveying movement and texture. The color palette is primarily monochromatic, with varying shades of brown emphasizing natural forms and textures.

artworks.title: Aeneas Saving His Father from Troy
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from two blocks in tan and black
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures. The central figure is carrying two smaller figures on their shoulder. They seem to be in motion, with a chaotic and fiery background. The figures display distress and vulnerability. The drawing features intricate linework and depicts a cityscape with smoke and flames on the left and vegetation on the right.

artworks.title: La Confidence
artworks.artist: Jacques-Firmin Beauvarlet after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: engraving
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 48.6 x 36.8 cm (19 1/8 x 14 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two women engaged in a seated position. The woman on the right is seated on what appears to be a cushioned bench, holding a thread and a small object in her hands, while the other woman kneels beside her, gesturing with her hands. The woman on the left has her head turned towards the seated woman, with her hair covered by a scarf or shawl. The seated woman has her head slightly inclined, with her hair tucked under a cap or headdress that is adorned. Both women are dressed in flowing, ornate garments with intricate patterns and detailed embroidery. The sitting woman wears a decorative necklace, and the surface they are on displays woven or knit materials. Behind them, a large piece of elaborately patterned drapery hangs, next to a window showing a faint landscape with a soft sky and trees.

artworks.title: Lion Hunt
artworks.artist: Pieter Claesz Soutman and Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brownish-gray wash over black chalk, some red chalk at the lower left and at bottom center, touches of heightening with white, vertical fold through the center, incised for transfer
